Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing deck & estimate for Acme Corp — discovery recap + next steps

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the candid discussion about Acme's latency and cost requirements for the new search assistant. Quick recap from our side: 

- Priority: ship a low-latency, cost-predictable model for customer-facing search by Q3.
- Key constraints: 99th pct latency under 200ms, customer data residency (US), and strict audit logging.
- Win criteria: accurate reranking of top-10 results with <5% regression vs current baseline and predictable per-token cost.

I've attached the pricing deck and a short estimate that maps the three options we discussed (Hosted API, Dedicated reserved capacity, Private deployment). High-level recommendation: start with a Dedicated pool for predictable throughput and enable KV caching and batching to reduce token spend.

Attachments:
- 20260610-Acme-Pricing-Deck.pdf (1.1 MB)
- 20260610-Acme-Estimate.xlsx (34 KB)

Next steps I proposed on the call:
1) Get you the detailed estimate (attached) — done.
2) Decision on preferred deployment option by end of next week (we can extend if needed).
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 20-min walkthrough of the deck and underlying assumptions.

Are you able to confirm receipt of the deck? Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the numbers and the recommended tradeoffs. I can do 9–11am PT on Thursday or Friday, but I can flex to match your calendar.

Best,

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: (415) 555-0142 | dylan.brooks@redwood.com
